name: Agents API
summary: OpenAI's hosted agent API (beta) that runs a managed Codex harness in durable sessions, with OpenAI managing orchestration and recovery while the agent works in an OpenAI-hosted or self-hosted sandbox.

skills.what: Agents API sessions discover Agent Skills (directories with a SKILL.md, compatible with the open Agent Skills standard) in the sandbox directories listed in environment.capability_directories; the Agents API is in beta.

mcp.what: MCP connections reach HTTP servers from OpenAI (connection_origin "service", the default) or from the session's environment (connection_origin "environment"), and the executor can start a server over stdio inside the environment.

plugins.what: Plugins package skills, MCP configuration or both in the .codex-plugin/plugin.json layout, registered through environment.capability_directories in a self-hosted sandbox or uploaded as a ZIP in environment.plugins for an OpenAI-hosted sandbox.

scheduled-work.what: Scheduled automations start new sessions or continue an existing session on a cron schedule with a time zone, and the automations tool lets an agent schedule its own follow-ups.

sandboxes.what: An OpenAI-hosted sandbox (environment.type openai_hosted) gives the agent a Linux workspace with a chosen container size and network access controls, or a self-hosted sandbox runs commands through the codex exec-server executor on the customer's own compute.
